reason: As someone who remembers the refunds and has already given this month, B answers my doubts directly: it names the Majestic, shows $36,000 already committed so only $49,000 is left, guarantees all-or-nothing refunds, admits the roof cost risk, and promises public spending reports and a Thanksgiving opening. A has unfilled placeholders, a bracketed refund line, and asks for $60,000 with fewer assurances.
